rendering: native vector geometry and DirectWrite text; official artwork uses source-appropriate SVG or PNG

interaction.singleTap: launch preferred local application; resolve recognized legacy website defaults through installed-app discovery; open native executable/shortcut picker when unavailable; never fall back to a website
interaction.hold: open at pointer center; release commits a target or opens the unified + hub
interaction.menuContinuation: secondary settings remain open for deliberate adjustment
interaction.back: center or Esc returns one level

motion.implementation: Windows Composition opacity and scale; one-shot exit completion only
motion.hidden: detach composition tree; stop active animations

colorPolicy.accent: Windows accent for selection outlines and indicators
colorPolicy.vendorArtwork: preserve official proportions and recognizable colors
colorPolicy.highContrast: actual system surfaces and readable outlines; preview colors illustrative

frosted.preview: tonal illustration; native backdrop requires runtime validation

systemAppearance.delivery: coalesce on UI thread; preserve menu context and selection

iconography.renderer: verified vendor artwork plus native command vectors
iconography.identity: preserve official artwork and use consistent container geometry
iconography.rasterException: official PNG or same-artwork PNG when SVG unavailable or unsupported; never UI animation frames

management: presets with five items per page
osd.editor: focused native task sheet for name and actual launch target
osd.missingPreset: open focused local-target editor; do not substitute a website
osd.defaultTargets: up to six installed native applications, then Notepad and Windows Settings
osd.legacyMigration: known ChatGPT and Claude base-URL defaults only; back up configuration before automatic save; preserve arbitrary/custom URLs
osd.missingPreferredTarget: native Choose a local application picker restricted to exe/lnk; replace selected launch profile before opening
osd.customWebTargets: explicit wheel selection only; never a short-tap fallback
osd.centerContent: empty on idle Main; back chevron on idle submenus; one concise functional name for the selected app or secondary command
osd.centerLabelPolicy: show the hovered item name, including Language, Appearance, Preferred agent, Manage apps, and Add app; never add a second line or helper prompt
osd.appearanceIcon: sun for system light mode; moon for system dark mode

edgeLayout.interior: center the complete reel on the actual pointer with zero offset
edgeLayout.edge: clamp complete footprint to current monitor work area
edgeLayout.corner: preserve circle and minimally clamp both axes
edgeLayout.origin: final visible center is the armed hit-test origin
edgeLayout.guard: only when boundary clamping places the pointer outside the center zone, keep selection empty until center entry; early release cancels
edgeLayout.smallWorkArea: scale the complete canvas uniformly; validate reduced text and target sizes
edgeLayout.layoutContract: rendering and hit testing share final center and geometry

handoff.svg: editable vector UI scenes with embedded verified source artwork
handoff.pdf: embedded fonts and vector UI; official PNG sources retained for review
